identificationModule.briefTitle: Soy Protein/Effexor Hormone Therapy for Prostate Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: Randomized Study of Soy Protein and Effexor on Vasomotor Symptoms of Men With Prostate Cancer

armGroups.label: Arm I - Placebo
armGroups.description: Patients receive oral placebo pill and oral placebo powder once daily.

armGroups.label: Arm II - Soy
armGroups.description: Patients receive oral placebo pill and oral soy protein/isoflavones powder once daily.
interventionNames: Dietary Supplement: oral soy protein/isoflavones powder

armGroups.label: Arm III - Venlafaxine
armGroups.description: Patients receive oral Venlafaxine pill and placebo powder once daily.

armGroups.label: Arm IV - Soy + Venlafaxine
armGroups.description: Patients receive oral Venlafaxine pill and soy protein/isoflavones powder once daily.
interventionNames: Dietary Supplement: oral soy protein/isoflavones powder

interventions.name: oral soy protein/isoflavones powder
interventions.description: Soy protein powder (20gm) orally 160 mg of total isoflavones isocaloric supplement of casein protein

interventions.name: Placebo Powder
interventions.description: Placebo powder (20gm casein protein) orally 0 mg of total isoflavones
